ValidationRule.description: Requires a nurture track for leads that are sent to be nurtured
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.Id = "01280000000UDKP", OR ( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Nurture - Marketing"),ISPICKVAL(Status, "Nurture - Sales Engagement")),ISPICKVAL( Nurture_Track__c , ""))
